searchText: <Marcin> - We didn't do anything with prometheus, it's probably just a wishful placeholder :) - Ren: nginx, one more thing it would make sense to use it for is statically serving the `transcript.json` file, rather than have an endpoint for it in the app. Hey, I am writing a client implementation for the ceremony, are there some contribution json examples I can use as part of my testing? <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> Hi! 😊 there is a initial transcript json file in the specifications https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <Stefan Bratanov> Hey, I am writing a client implementation for the ceremony, are there some contribution json examples I can use as part of my testing?) <CarlBeek> > <CarlBeek> i was thinking of using nginx cache to help out with this. it is an unauthenticated endpoint so we can just cache with a 16 second time-out (re @Marcin: - We didn't do anything with prometheus, it's probably just a wishful placeholder :) - Ren: nginx, one more thing it would make sense to use it for is statically serving the transcript.json file, rather than have an endpoint for it in the app.) <trent_vanepps> what's a reasonable timeframe to transition to the "beefy server"? <trent_vanepps> @CarlBeek / anyone at EF devops <CarlBeek> i should have a doc for review by EOD and we can start a deployment after feedback on that <CarlBeek> Part of having this whole thing being trusted not to censor is people being assured that the deployment is safe <trent_vanepps> separately, are there any remaining tasks for finalizing the sequencer code? want to make sure we are tying up loose ends well in advance of the audit

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<Marcin> - We didn't do anything with prometheus, it's probably just a wishful placeholder :) 
- Ren: nginx, one more thing it would make sense to use it for is statically serving the `transcript.json` file, rather than have an endpoint for it in the app.
